interface.shortDescription: Create or update a reusable personal Codex artifact-template skill. Use when the user invokes $templ
interface.longDescription: Create or update a reusable personal Codex artifact-template skill. Use when the user invokes $template-creator or asks in natural language to create a template using, from, or based on an attached Word document, PowerPoint presentation, or Excel workbook, or explicitly asks to edit or update a passed artifact-template skill. Do not use for one-off artifact creation from an existing template.
